meta.title: diep-fried.io Content Catalog & Completeness Matrix Data
meta.description: Documentary catalog of playable classes, special entities, weapon families, upgrade paths, shapes, bosses, stats, and game modes for diep-fried.io. This file is plain data: it is NOT validated against any formal schema; integrity rules are listed in meta.integrityRules and checked by review scripts/tests to be written.

verificationCategories.verified: Directly observed in the browser client (23 Oct 2026). Only used for the presence of game-mode selectors in the DOM.
verificationCategories.documented: Reported by public community documentation (Fandom wiki, DiepInDepth, changelogs). Applies to class existence, tier, level and upgrade edges. Numeric parameters on the same entries are NOT individually verified.
verificationCategories.estimated: Game design parameter chosen by the diep-fried.io project; a proposal to be validated, not a fact about the original game.
verificationCategories.unresolved: Known ambiguous or version-dependent mechanic requiring clarification or empirical calibration.

parameterStatusValues.to-validate: Numeric/behavioural parameter (FOV multiplier, barrel count, caps, timers, HP/XP values, colours) copied from community sources or proposed by the research agent; must be validated before being used as a binding requirement.

integrityRules: tank ids and names are unique; exactly 54 tanks with tier counts 1/4/13/36
every id in upgradesFrom/upgradesTo exists and the relation is symmetric
parents always have a strictly lower tier and levelRequirement than their children; the graph is acyclic and every tank is reachable from 'tank'
weaponFamily and secondaryFamilies refer to keys of weaponFamilies; representativeTanks of a family are exactly the tanks whose primary weaponFamily is that key
tier counts must not be derived from wiki categories, which also list legacy/removed tanks

versionConventions.target: Remake conventions are chosen explicitly where the original game changed over time. When sources disagree, the convention below wins and the older behaviour is recorded as legacy.
versionConventions.dualBarrel: Coordinator verification (23 Oct 2026): the changelog reports a Dual-Barrel change on 2 Nov 2025 (two cannons fired by left click, staggered). Remake convention: current behaviour (left click / Space fires both barrels, staggered); the legacy right-click convention is NOT implemented in v1. The changelog entry itself was not re-read by the reviewer (HTTP 402 from the wiki).

meta.familyNote: weaponFamilies is a classification chosen for this catalog (design decision), not an official game taxonomy. weaponFamily is the primary family; secondaryFamilies lists additional traits.

reconciliation51vs54.summary: Resolution of the class count delta between preliminary inventory (51 tanks) and official tier count (54 normal tanks).
reconciliation51vs54.historicalContext: The preliminary inventory in docs/research/diep-io-inventaire.md noted 51 tanks: 1 Tier 1, 4 Tier 2, 12 Tier 3, and 34 Tier 4. Official game documentation confirms 54 normal playable tanks.

reconciliation51vs54.confirmation: 54 normal classes confirmed by the coordinator on https://diepio.fandom.com/wiki/Upgrades (23 Oct 2026), including Shotgun, Pellet Shot and Dual-Barrel. Wiki categories also contain legacy tanks and must not be counted automatically. Multi-parent upgrade edges (quad-tank, auto-5, auto-gunner, streamliner, gunner-trapper, overtrapper, battleship) and the Auto Tank / Sprayer / Smasher level rules are recorded as documented but were not re-verified edge by edge during this review.

single-cannon.name: Single Cannon / Direct Fire
single-cannon.description: Standard forward-facing barrel delivering focused linear projectiles with balanced speed, penetration, and recoil.

twin-spammer.name: Twin & Multi-Barrel Spammers
twin-spammer.description: Multiple parallel or angled forward barrels providing high bullet density, area suppression, and significant combined recoil thrust.

sniper.name: Sniper & Long-Range Recon
sniper.description: Elongated barrels firing high-velocity, high-damage bullets with lower rate of fire and elevated Field of View (FOV).

heavy-cannon.name: Heavy Cannon & High Recoil
heavy-cannon.description: Large-bore barrels firing high-inertia, high-damage or high-recoil projectiles, used for burst damage, rocket thrusters, or artillery.

shotgun-burst.name: Shotgun & Pellet Spread
shotgun-burst.description: Wide burst firing volleys of miniature pellets with high spread, high close-quarters lethality, and significant knockback/recoil.

drone-controller.name: Drone & Minion Controller
drone-controller.description: Spawners generating autonomous or mouse-guided drones (Doritos), square minions, or swarm drones that seek cursor target.

trapper.name: Trapper & Kinetic Barriers
trapper.description: Deployers of semi-static triangular kinetic spikes that persist in the arena, block enemy fire, and damage ramming enemies.

smasher-ram.name: Smasher & Rammer
smasher-ram.description: Heavily armored or thruster-accelerated hulls designed to eliminate targets through physical collision rather than gunfire.

auto-turret.name: Autonomous Turrets
auto-turret.description: Tanks equipped with independently targeting 360-degree secondary AI turrets that track and engage targets autonomously.

flank-thruster.name: Flank Guard & Thruster Hulls
flank-thruster.description: Mixed forward barrels with rear/side cannons or thrusters; mobility from rear-facing fire.

rapid-fire.name: Rapid Fire / Machine Gun
rapid-fire.description: High fire rate, wide random spread, continuous bullet streams.

pointGainSchedule.levelRangeContinuous: Levels 2 to 28 (1 point per level = 27 points)

attributes.name: Health Regen
attributes.description: Increases health regeneration rate. Regeneration accelerates exponentially after 30 seconds without taking damage.

attributes.name: Max Health
attributes.description: Increases total maximum hit points of the tank chassis.

attributes.name: Body Damage
attributes.description: Increases damage dealt upon physical contact with shapes, projectiles, and enemy tanks; acts as damage reduction armor against incoming collisions.

attributes.name: Bullet Speed
attributes.description: Increases muzzle velocity and flight travel speed of fired projectiles, drones, and traps.

attributes.name: Bullet Penetration
attributes.description: Increases projectile durability / hit points, allowing bullets to survive multiple impacts with shapes or opposing bullets before expiring.

attributes.name: Bullet Damage
attributes.description: Increases destructive damage applied by each bullet, drone, or trap impact per collision tick.

attributes.name: Reload
attributes.description: Decreases time delay between successive shots; accelerates drone reproduction rate and trap deployment rate.

attributes.name: Movement Speed
attributes.description: Increases base acceleration and maximum directional velocity across the arena grid.

stats.note: Point caps and the 33-point schedule are documented; the Stats page itself states some values are approximate. smasherMaxPoints 0 means 'stat disabled' for Smasher, Landmine and Spike only; Auto Smasher keeps bullet stats.

gameModes.name: Free For All (FFA)
gameModes.description: Every player fights for themselves. Leaderboard tracks top score in room. Respawn at max(1, min(22, floor(level/2))) (remake proposal).
